Both work well. Deleting one directly from its card is the main thing I need — that covers removing a link when I no longer want it. This second version just lets me tick off several at once and clear them in one go, with the same confirm step, which is a nice convenience when I'm tidying up a bunch at a time.

The individual delete control is the essential one for me, so if you only build one, that's the one to keep. But if it's easy to have both, I'd happily take the multi-select too — it's a helpful extra. I'll leave that to you.
